story_review.one_viewing_summary: Planned chain, not observed. A lattice tower's camera head spins once over dry plains and leaves a watch ring while a wisp rises. Sixteen of 56 slots light and 56 planned by February 2027 pins. The beam finds the plume and a flag box locks. The alert card leaves the head, runs down the coax to a crew truck and lands on a gloved phone. On the watch a hatched window opens and Estimated within ten minutes pins. The beam holds on the burning plume under Doesn't prevent fires. In a foreground two-shot a dashed line leaves the alert at the truck and stops short of a responder badge on the station gable with Can share below. A calendar since launch shows no red mark. A blank Response record pulses empty. The plan folder shows an open State approval slot and Expected January 2027, and the composite closes on the tower, the landed alert and the open line.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what happens when a tower camera sees smoke and ends with the alert at the crew, the responder line open, no response record and the plan awaiting the state.
story_review.weakest_transition: s4 to s5 at 22.78 s, from an extreme close on the watch face to the wide plains world.
